input.note:
The doc-embedder pod is stuck in Pending because the GPU node pool has a taint `dedicated: gpu` that the pod doesn't tolerate. The pod scheduling condition shows "3 node(s) had untolerated taint {dedicated: gpu}". 

The pod currently has a toleration for `nvidia.com/gpu` but is missing a toleration for the `dedicated: gpu` taint. According to Kubernetes documentation, pods need matching tolerations for each taint on a node [cite: concepts/scheduling-eviction/taint-and-toleration#intro-0].

Fix: Add a toleration to the doc-embedder deployment spec for the `dedicated: gpu` taint:
```yaml
tolerations:
- key: "dedicated"
  operator: "Equal"
  value: "gpu"
  effect: "NoSchedule"
```

This will allow the pod to be scheduled on the GPU nodes alongside the ml-serving team's pods (which presumably already have this toleration).
